title: Resolve Pixelscan no-proxy fingerprint inconsistency

Low-sensitive diagnostic showed the actual status line plus cards for Browser, Location, Fingerprint, WebRTC IP Address, Timezone from JS, HardwareConcurency, Language, Languages from Javascript, Accept-Language header, and Hardware. IPhey home loaded as Trustworthy, but /leaks returned an edge error page, so the Pixelscan/IPhey gate remains incomplete. Investigate the root cause without storing screenshots, cookies, local storage, headers, tokens, IP values, profile dir contents, or full page text.
acceptance_criteria: No-proxy Pixelscan/IPhey external smoke can be rerun from a temporary Docker manager and proves no IP/timezone/language/WebRTC/hardware/software high-risk inconsistency; diagnostic evidence is low-sensitive only; release checklist and cbim-23h.1 notes are updated; full quality gates are rerun if code changes.
